_doc: Tech node gate for the Ars Nouveau port (DiaithirRPG #264 node magic.glyphs, Age VI). Everything in the listed namespaces is locked until the node is researched; age_gates.json gives the same items Age VI as the fallback when no tech tree is loaded. Not a Spell Engine file.

school.name: Lietirrùan
school.note: Casting an Ars Nouveau glyph spell counts as the glyph school for caster XP and school unlock; the eight rune spells (diaithir_druidry:rune_*) are the Spell Engine side of the same school.
